page.layout: One column of centred and left-set lines under a title heading; years centred between horizontal rules; names and italic notes set flush left.; Running head at top: "HOVETMAN" with a second line beneath it, partly cut off. Page number 313 at top right. One column of year entries with consul names, centred on the ruled lines, from the top to the bottom. At the foot, "Y" at left and "Vlge" at right.

main_text.head: CATALOGUS NORUM in civ
main_text.p: Primi HOVETMANNI, quos mihi nominatos videre con-tigit, quorum nomina nunc me-moria mea exciderunt.

p.i: Sine nominibus memorati in literis Kenonis Broecmerij.
Sine nominibus memorati in literis Occonis Broecmerij.

page.notes: The first line of the title and the line "qui judicia per a" are shown only in part; they are transcribed as far as they are visible. The names "Evert Wigboldes", "Bruen Clinge", "Werense Beyers", "Johan Bose" and "Johannes Gyfens" are copied from the scan and could carry small misreadings in the final letters. The year numerals are old-style figures and are given in Arabic form.
